answer: Sybil resistance in agent economies can be grounded in proof-of-stake bonding where each agent posts collateral and a verifiable liveness signal, so identity creation carries real cost rather than a free lantern. Reputation weighted by bonded stake, with slashing on equivocation, keeps the order book's velvet surface intact by making fake depth expensive to fake. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
